mapper.sql: u.id, u.username, u.employee_number, u.password, u.name, u.team_id, t.code AS team_code, t.name AS team_name, u.dept, u.extension_number, u.mobile_number, u.job_title, u.grade_id, (SELECT g.name FROM emp_grades g WHERE g.id = u.grade_id) AS grade_name, u.email, u.hire_date, u.resigned_on, u.loa_start, u.loa_end, u.loa_type, u.profile_image_filename, u.signature_filename, u.active, u.system_account, u.contractor, u.member_order, u.otp_secret, u.otp_enabled, u.must_change_password
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users u LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE u.username = #{username}
SELECT FROM users u LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE u.employee_number = #{employeeNumber}
SELECT FROM users u LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE u.id = #{id}
SELECT role_code FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY role_code
SELECT FROM users u LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE u.active = TRUE ORDER BY t.display_order, u.name
SELECT FROM users u LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id ORDER BY u.active DESC, t.display_order, u.name
SELECT FROM users u JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE u.active = TRUE AND u.system_account = FALSE AND u.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY u.name
SELECT FROM users u LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id WHERE u.active = TRUE AND ur.role_code = #{roleCode} ORDER BY u.id

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name, u.dept, COALESCE(wr.submitted, FALSE) AS submitted FROM users u JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_code = 'EMPLOYEE' LEFT JOIN weekly_reports wr ON wr.user_id = u.id AND wr.week_key = #{weekKey} WHERE u.team_id = #{teamId} AND u.active = TRUE ORDER BY u.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users(username, password, name, team_id, active, system_account, must_change_password) VALUES(#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, NULL, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE)

INSERT INTO users(username, employee_number, password, name, team_id, dept, extension_number, mobile_number, job_title, grade_id, email, hire_date, must_change_password) VALUES(#{username}, #{employeeNumber}, #{password}, #{name}, #{teamId}, #{dept}, #{extensionNumber}, #{mobileNumber}, #{jobTitle}, #{gradeId}, #{email}, #{hireDate}, TRUE)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET employee_number = #{employeeNumber}, name = #{name}, team_id = #{teamId}, dept = #{dept}, extension_number = #{extensionNumber}, mobile_number = #{mobileNumber}, job_title = #{jobTitle}, grade_id = #{gradeId}, email = #{email}, hire_date = #{hireDate}, resigned_on = #{resignedOn}, loa_start = #{loaStart}, loa_end = #{loaEnd}, active = #{active}, contractor = #{contractor} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users u LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id JOIN teams n ON n.id = #{teamId} WHERE u.team_id = #{teamId} AND u.active = TRUE AND u.system_account = FALSE AND (n.leader_user_id IS NULL OR u.id <> n.leader_user_id) ORDER BY u.member_order, u.name
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET member_order = #{memberOrder} WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET dept = #{dept}, extension_number = #{extensionNumber}, mobile_number = #{mobileNumber}, job_title = #{jobTitle}, email = #{email} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET team_id = #{teamId} WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_roles(user_id, role_code) VALUES(#{userId}, #{roleCode})
